Game Overview

Survival by Boat is a monster title where set sail on a captivating maritime adventure where every decision counts. Navigate vast oceans, discover mysterious islands, and forge unexpected alliances. Balance resource management with strategic exploration and build your story in a world thriving on danger and discovery. Will you conquer the unknown or be swept away?
